notes: Read all 215 source lines before porting. Imports L1-15: forwardRef/HTMLAttributes (L1) -> forwardRef<View> + native prop interface; react-router-dom Link (L2) -> Pressable + onNavigate(to) callback; react-i18next useTranslation (L3) -> inline English-default t(key, fallback, vars?) with {{var}} interpolation; cn (L4) -> StyleSheet/style arrays; fmtInt/fmtNumber (L5) -> inline locale-aware toLocaleString helpers; GlassPanel (L6) -> glass-surfaced root View carrying ref; RadialGauge (L7) -> native RadialGauge port (../charts/RadialGauge); StatusBadge (L8) -> inline VehicleStatusBadge; StatCard (L9) -> inline StatTile; Badge (L10) -> inline ModelBadge pill; Grid (L11) -> flex-wrap statGrid; FSM_REGISTRY (L12) -> inline VEHICLE_STATE_KEYS + STATE_DOT_COLOR map; useUnits (L13) + convertDistanceFromSI/convertTempFromSI (L14) -> inline SI converters reading native useSettings; VehicleStatus (L15) -> string.

Props interface L17-44 ported: vehicle {id,display_name,model,vin,state} and vehicleState {battery_level,rated_range,inside_temp,outside_temp,odometer,is_charging,is_locked,sentry_mode,software_version,power,state?} kept verbatim (split into VehicleHeroCardVehicle/VehicleHeroCardState); photoUrl?:string|null with its multi-card doc comment preserved (L38-42); HTMLAttributes/className DOM surface replaced with native className no-op + style/testID/data-testid + onNavigate.

toStatus L46-48 preserved: returns the state when it is one of the 7 FSM vehicle keys, else 'offline' (web `state in FSM_REGISTRY.vehicle.states`). STATE_DOT_COLOR resolves the exact web badgeDot tailwind shades to hex (online #4ade80, driving #3b82f6, charging #facc15, parked #06b6d4, updating #6366f1, asleep #a855f7, offline #f87171, fallback #9ca3af).

Unit math L54-74 preserved with identical variable names: vs, distanceLabel, temperatureLabel, odometerDisplay (fmtInt+Math.round+convertDistanceFromSI, '—' when no state), rangeDisplay, insideTempDisplay, outsideTempDisplay (Math.round + convert, 0 when no state), rangeMax (km?644:400), tempMax (°C?50:122). Suffixes pull from settings (unit_of_length->mi/km, unit_of_temp->°F/°C) exactly like web useUnits; ?? 0 null-safety on every SI field retained.

Photo block L84-95: -> rounded overflow-hidden photoFrame View + resizeMode='cover' height 288 (max-h-72), alt -> accessibilityLabel via t('vehicleHero.photo.alt','{{name}} photo',{name}); browser-only loading='lazy'/decoding='async' have no native analog and are dropped (documented).

Identity block L97-113: display_name h2 -> AppText title/bold; StatusBadge(toStatus(vehicleState?.state ?? vehicle.state ?? 'offline')) L104 preserved exactly; vin font-mono -> AppText caption tone=muted fontFamily monospace; Badge variant=neutral size=sm model chip -> ModelBadge pill.

Gauges L115-151 (gated by vs): 4 RadialGauge calls with identical value/max/label/unit/color/size — battery (max 100, unit %, color battery_level>20?#22d3ee:#ef4444), range (rangeMax, distanceLabel, #4ade80), inside (tempMax, temperatureLabel, #f59e0b), outside (tempMax, temperatureLabel, #a78bfa), all size 100. Hidden when state is null, matching the source.

Detail cards L153-179 (gated by vs): Grid default:2/md:4 -> statGrid flex-wrap of 2-up StatTiles; all 8 StatCards ported with identical label keys/fallbacks/values/units — insideTemp, outsideTemp, odometer, range, status (is_locked Locked/Unlocked), sentry (common.on/off On/Off), firmware (software_version), power (fmtNumber(power) + kW). Power uses settings decimal_precision (web global precision) and locale.

Navigation actions L181-210: 3 Links -> 3 HeroAction Pressables with accessibilityRole='link'; to-paths carried verbatim (/vehicles/{id}, /vehicles/{id}/commands, /vehicles/{id}/map) and fired through onNavigate; details = cyan-tinted primary, commands/liveMap = surface ghost, matching the web tints. forwardRef + displayName='VehicleHeroCard' (L211-215) preserved. No DOM elements, react-router, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide, or web UI components imported; verified via tsc --noEmit, eslint --quiet, and jest.
